create_iterator_enwik9: create an iterator that yields enwik9 text chunks of configurable size
create_iterator_librispeech: create an iterator that yields librispeech audio patches converted to 8-bit mono
create_iterator_imagenet: create an iterator that yields imagenet image patches converted to grayscale
create_iterator_random: create an iterator that yields random bytes chunks of fixed size
use_data_generator_dict: use the GET_DATA_GENERATOR_FN_DICT to look up a data generator by dataset name
